title: Prohibited acts; flammable solvents.
bodyText:
(a) No qualifying patient, primary caregiver, qualifying out-of-state patient, or caregiver of a qualifying out-of-state patient shall use butane to extract tetrahydrocannabinol from cannabis plants.

(b) Any person who violates this section shall be guilty of a class C felony.
bodyHtml:
§329-129  Prohibited acts; flammable solvents.  (a)  No qualifying patient, primary caregiver, qualifying out-of-state patient, or caregiver of a qualifying out-of-state patient shall use butane to extract tetrahydrocannabinol from cannabis plants.

     (b)  Any person who violates this section shall be guilty of a class C felony. [L 2015, c 241, pt of §5; am L 2018, c 116, §11]
